changed: On a shared list, the worn and consumable marks are quieter, and appear only on rows that differ from their folder — so a Worn folder no longer repeats itself down every row.
Shared lists no longer print "×1" on every single-item row, and show the route's distance beside its name.
fixed: A shared water row counts its whole line, so two 1 L bottles read "2 L" instead of "1 L".
